text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.The guardian shall provide the following personal materials :1. The guardian is a Chinese citizen: resident ID card; Bank deposit certificate (the amount is not less than RMB 100,000 yuan, and the deadline must be greater than January 31 of the following year); Guardian Guarantee (please click to download). 2. Guardian is a foreign citizen: copy of passport (information page); Non-student residence permit (valid later than January 31 of the second year of application); Bank deposit certificate (the amount is not less than RMB 100,000 yuan, and the deadline must be greater than January 31 of the following year); Guardian bond.
